source_format: ArcGIS MapServer query (JSON/GeoJSON); paid countywide taxlot package also sold with signed Data Disclaimer

policy.summary: A public AddressParcel MapServer exposes parcel polygons (includes owner/mailing/value fields — strip before any publish). Separately, Lane County sells countywide taxlot geometry ($100) only after a signed Data Disclaimer; LCOG parcel products require a signed license agreement. No open-data clause found that clearly allows public CDN re-host or selling derived property-intel products. Treat as not cleared for derive-and-sell until Jonah obtains written terms covering redistributed geometry and commercial derivatives.
policy.terms_notes: EPIL web disclaimer is warranty/accuracy only. Data Sales page requires signed Data Disclaimer before taxlot delivery. Do not equate public MapServer access with redistribution rights.

viewer_outline.notes: No open clause found allowing display of parcel boundaries in a commercial viewer. Paid taxlots require signed Data Disclaimer — ask explicitly about end-user outline display.

workflow_clip.notes: Public MapServer ≠ commercial processing rights. Clip-only automation still needs written clearance before relying on it in a sold product.

notes: Oracle training county. keep_properties must strip owner fields present on the live layer.

retrieval_log.detail: GET layer?f=pjson (fields include OWNNAME/ADDR*). query returnCountOnly → 159145. No usable last_edited_date statistic on probed fields. Source CRS wk id 2914 (Oregon North ft).

Paginate MapServer/2/query where=1=1 outFields=OBJECTID,MAPTAXLOT,MAPNUMBER,TAXLOT,MAPACRES (omit owner/mailing/value) returnGeometry=true outSR=4326 f=geojson; page with resultOffset (maxRecordCount 2000). Alternate: purchase taxlot package from Lane GIS (lcgis@lanecountyor.gov) after signed Data Disclaimer — still need redistribution language for CDN.
Classified unknown; redistribute_public=false; derive_and_sell=false pending signed terms review.
Split product rights into viewer_outline (customer-visible lot line) and workflow_clip (server-side clip/PIP). Both remain allowed=false pending written clearance.
